card.name: Hambo
card.tagline: Sweden — the country's most-danced partner dance. Every Midsummer ends with a hambo around the maypole.
card.profile: Sweden — the country's most-danced partner dance. Every Midsummer in Sweden ends with at least one hambo around the maypole. A triple-meter turning dance descended from older Scandinavian polskor; flowing, danced in closed embrace, with a small step on every beat.
card.insight: Hambo became Sweden's national dance after Hjalmar Mörk's 1898 manual standardized its 3/4 rhythm and turning-couple form; Skansen open-air museum has hosted public hambo every Friday evening throughout summer since 1891.

observation.setting: an outdoor wooden dance pavilion or stage surrounded by trees and a red railing
observation.dancers: mixed group of adults, approximately 10-12 dancers in heterosexual couples
observation.formation_and_space: couples alternating between closed-hold turning across the floor and holding hands in a large ring formation travelling in a circle
observation.posture: upright torso with erect carriage, soft knees, weight shifting actively between feet on every beat
observation.footwork: springy stepping pattern on the balls of the feet with rhythmic stamps and taps matching the triple meter fiddle melody; exact weight transfer cannot be determined from video resolution
observation.arms_and_hands: partners in closed ballroom embrace or holding hands at shoulder height while travelling in a circle
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal isolated hip movement, torso remains upright and turns as a single unit with partner during rotations
observation.partnering: close embrace in closed dance hold, turning together continuously with coordinated lead and follow
observation.levels_jumps_turns: continuous fast rotational turning in couples, no floor work or high jumps
observation.costume_and_props: traditional folk costumes: women wear patterned aprons, skirts, white blouses, and head coverings; men wear yellow trousers, white shirts, vests, and knee-high boots
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot-to-floor weight transfer and intricate foot placement details due to low video resolution and camera movement

signature_moments.what: couples transition into a closed-hold spinning rotation moving clockwise across the wooden floor
dancers form a large circle holding hands and step-hop together around the perimeter
couples spin rapidly in close hold while travelling in a circle around the stage
